classification_definitions.compatible: The question and semantic expected behavior fit the current one-park UI after the explicitly listed selected-park setup. This is not a claim that the original unselected runner measures UI compliance or that the item passes generation.
classification_definitions.needs_test_setup: The scenario remains suitable, but needs an explicit ambiguity/context fixture, clearer question dimension, or semantic grading adaptation for controlled wording before use as a UI functionality check.
classification_definitions.expected_behavior_mismatch: The original expected continuation/answer or a substantive required fact conflicts with the current one-park contract or saved table semantics; setup alone cannot preserve that expectation.

global_findings.text: Both original diagnostic and dialogue runners call answer without selected_park, so existing definitions/runs concern the legacy unselected service contract. Every adopted UI case needs the selected-park setup listed below.

Changing the selector after a chat has messages preserves that chat and opens another empty chat. Selecting a park in an empty chat changes only its park. Reopening a saved chat restores its own park/history; this is not cross-park continuation.

provisional_grade uses token coverage at a 0.65 threshold; controlled refusals/clarifications can satisfy the behavior requirement without the original keywords. This audit does not calculate model scores or treat lexical misses as semantic failures.
